summary: A mixed legal and business day dominated by Reliance's debt fundraising plans and retail sector growth targets, alongside a Kerala High Court ruling on criminal procedure. Key driver: Reliance's Rs 10,000 crore debt fundraise and multiple retail companies announcing aggressive expansion timelines.

bullets.text: Reliance Industries eyes Rs 10,000 crore debt fundraise, also planning up to $1 billion in local currency bonds.
Swiss Beauty Select projects over 100% growth, targeting revenues exceeding Rs 70 crore by FY26-27 and Rs 100 crore target.
Decathlon targets Rs 1,000 crore running sports business in 4 years, expanding northeast with first Guwahati store.
Kerala High Court quashed criminal case against man who mistakenly held national flag upside down.
Trans ACNR Solutions and 8 other companies filed IPO papers with Sebi for capital fundraising.
